theorem QOU.StandardModel.PolarizationHecke.conj_braid {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] {x y u v : A} (hvu : v * u = 1) (h : x * y * x = y * x * y) :
u * x * v * (u * y * v) * (u * x * v) = u * y * v * (u * x * v) * (u * y * v)

theorem QOU.StandardModel.PolarizationHecke.conj_hecke {K : Type u_1} [Field K] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra K A] (q : K) {x u v : A} (huv : u * v = 1) (hvu : v * u = 1) (hx : hecke q x) :
hecke q (u * x * v)

theorem QOU.StandardModel.PolarizationHecke.conj_add_smul {K : Type u_1} [Field K] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra K A] {u v : A} (huv : u * v = 1) (x : A) (s : K) :
u * x * v + s • 1 = u * (x + s • 1) * v

theorem QOU.StandardModel.PolarizationHecke.no_automorphism_to_orthogonal_pair {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (hq : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : q ^ 2 + 1 ≠ 0) (f : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K →+* Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K) (hf : Function.Injective ⇑f) (P : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K) (hP : P * P = P) (a b c d : K) :
¬(f (s0 q) = a • P + b • (1 - P) ∧ f (s1 q) = c • P + d • (1 - P))

theorem QOU.StandardModel.PolarizationHecke.s_noncomm {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (hq : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : q ^ 2 + 1 ≠ 0) :
s0 q * s1 q ≠ s1 q * s0 q

s0 q * s1 q * s0 q = s1 q * s0 q * s1 q

theorem QOU.Tetraplectic.orth_pair_eq_leftMul_std {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {p₁ p₂ : BringCone R} (hp₁ : Quaternion.normSq p₁ = 1) (hre : (star p₁ * p₂).re = 0) (hi : (star p₁ * p₂).imI = 0) :
p₁ * 1 = p₁ ∧ p₁ * orthW (star p₁ * p₂).imJ (star p₁ * p₂).imK = p₂

theorem QOU.Tetraplectic.leftMul_preserves_orth {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {g : BringCone R} (hg : Quaternion.normSq g = 1) (p₁ p₂ : BringCone R) :
star (g * p₁) * (g * p₂) = star p₁ * p₂
